description: Test suite for language-hints module, validating functions that filter and normalize language hints for diff viewer payloads.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters the input list of language hints, keeping only supported languages, falls back to 'text' for invalid entries.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes language hints in diff viewer payloads, replacing unsupported or blank hints with 'text', and preserving valid languages.
